meta.title: Echo of Fate
meta.description: Answer the distant call and tread the long, dusty road.

units.rawText: <color=red>Warning! Anomalous data intrusion detected!</color>
units.displayText: Warning! Anomalous data intrusion detected!

spans.text: Warning! Anomalous data intrusion detected!

units.rawText: Were we spotted after all?!
units.displayText: Were we spotted after all?!

spans.text: Were we spotted after all?!

units.rawText: Tsk, that's a Greater Sanctifier for you. Even hacking a mere neural cloud fragment of his is so tricky...
units.displayText: Tsk, that's a Greater Sanctifier for you. Even hacking a mere neural cloud fragment of his is so tricky...

spans.text: Tsk, that's a Greater Sanctifier for you. Even hacking a mere neural cloud fragment of his is so tricky...

units.rawText: Activating cleansing system... Error Z01: module lost. Error Z58: module lost. Unable to connect to neural cloud core...
units.displayText: Activating cleansing system... Error Z01: module lost. Error Z58: module lost. Unable to connect to neural cloud core...

spans.text: Activating cleansing system... Error Z01: module lost. Error Z58: module lost. Unable to connect to neural cloud core...

units.rawText: Something's wrong with the data flow in the black hole... Oh no! Antonina, cut the connection now!
units.displayText: Something's wrong with the data flow in the black hole... Oh no! Antonina, cut the connection now!

spans.text: Something's wrong with the data flow in the black hole... Oh no! Antonina, cut the connection now!

units.rawText: It's too late... The fragment's alert program has locked onto us!
units.displayText: It's too late... The fragment's alert program has locked onto us!

spans.text: It's too late... The fragment's alert program has locked onto us!

units.rawText: Searching for security app, now running elimination program... Targets detected, quantity: 3.
units.displayText: Searching for security app, now running elimination program... Targets detected, quantity: 3.

spans.text: Searching for security app, now running elimination program... Targets detected, quantity: 3.

units.rawText: There's an unknown neural cloud approaching; look out!
units.displayText: There's an unknown neural cloud approaching; look out!

spans.text: There's an unknown neural cloud approaching; look out!

units.rawText: Professor, hold on to me!
units.displayText: Professor, hold on to me!

spans.text: Professor, hold on to me!

units.rawText: It can't be helped. All we can do is log out now!
units.displayText: It can't be helped. All we can do is log out now!

spans.text: It can't be helped. All we can do is log out now!

units.rawText: ...Professor...?
units.displayText: ...Professor...?

spans.text: ...Professor...?

units.rawText: Error... Program target error. Correcting... Targets detected, quantity: 1.
units.displayText: Error... Program target error. Correcting... Targets detected, quantity: 1.

spans.text: Error... Program target error. Correcting... Targets detected, quantity: 1.

units.rawText: Error... Neural cloud core detected, remaining integrity 27%. Ignoring error, now transferring control permissions.
units.displayText: Error... Neural cloud core detected, remaining integrity 27%. Ignoring error, now transferring control permissions.

spans.text: Error... Neural cloud core detected, remaining integrity 27%. Ignoring error, now transferring control permissions.

units.rawText: The fragmented warning tones overlap in the churning flow of data turbulence, and my body is tossed around in the data black hole like a leaf in a whirlpool.
units.displayText: The fragmented warning tones overlap in the churning flow of data turbulence, and my body is tossed around in the data black hole like a leaf in a whirlpool.

spans.text: The fragmented warning tones overlap in the churning flow of data turbulence, and my body is tossed around in the data black hole like a leaf in a whirlpool.

units.rawText: By the time I come to my senses, there is nobody else around me, only an oppressive external pressure that crushes down on my body and makes it difficult to stabilize my form.
units.displayText: By the time I come to my senses, there is nobody else around me, only an oppressive external pressure that crushes down on my body and makes it difficult to stabilize my form.

spans.text: By the time I come to my senses, there is nobody else around me, only an oppressive external pressure that crushes down on my body and makes it difficult to stabilize my form.

units.rawText: Suddenly, a soft sensation travels up my wrist and exerts just a little bit of force, enough to guide me into a relatively stable region of the data environment.
units.displayText: Suddenly, a soft sensation travels up my wrist and exerts just a little bit of force, enough to guide me into a relatively stable region of the data environment.

spans.text: Suddenly, a soft sensation travels up my wrist and exerts just a little bit of force, enough to guide me into a relatively stable region of the data environment.

units.rawText: Persicaria?
units.displayText: Persicaria?

spans.text: Persicaria?

units.rawText: Antonina?
units.displayText: Antonina?

spans.text: Antonina?

units.rawText: If you seek the two neural clouds that entered this data fragment with you, they are no longer here.
units.displayText: If you seek the two neural clouds that entered this data fragment with you, they are no longer here.

spans.text: If you seek the two neural clouds that entered this data fragment with you, they are no longer here.

units.rawText: They have already logged out. My strength is only sufficient to stabilize you, so I had to resort to this inferior alternative. My apologies.
units.displayText: They have already logged out. My strength is only sufficient to stabilize you, so I had to resort to this inferior alternative. My apologies.

spans.text: They have already logged out. My strength is only sufficient to stabilize you, so I had to resort to this inferior alternative. My apologies.

units.rawText: The gentle voice sounds tired, and the effects of the riptide gradually fade away. My vision returns to normal and a familiar form comes into view.
units.displayText: The gentle voice sounds tired, and the effects of the riptide gradually fade away. My vision returns to normal and a familiar form comes into view.

spans.text: The gentle voice sounds tired, and the effects of the riptide gradually fade away. My vision returns to normal and a familiar form comes into view.

units.rawText: I'm honored that you could address me so precisely.
units.displayText: I'm honored that you could address me so precisely.

spans.text: I'm honored that you could address me so precisely.

units.rawText: Oh my, Professor. Your face seems to be saying, "Oh no, the worst has come to pass".
units.displayText: Oh my, Professor. Your face seems to be saying, "Oh no, the worst has come to pass".

spans.text: Oh my, Professor. Your face seems to be saying, "Oh no, the worst has come to pass".

units.rawText: Still, you're certainly calm enough. It seems my plan to deal with a harsh interrogation has gone to waste.
units.displayText: Still, you're certainly calm enough. It seems my plan to deal with a harsh interrogation has gone to waste.

spans.text: Still, you're certainly calm enough. It seems my plan to deal with a harsh interrogation has gone to waste.
What do you want, Eosphorus?

options.rawText: Was there a need to specially take this form, Eosphorus?
options.displayText: Was there a need to specially take this form, Eosphorus?

spans.text: Was there a need to specially take this form, Eosphorus?

options.rawText: You're not Eosphorus; who are you?
options.displayText: You're not Eosphorus; who are you?

spans.text: You're not Eosphorus; who are you?

units.rawText: Don't tell me the fragment that Sol obtained from you at the cost of her life was part of your schemes too?
units.displayText: Don't tell me the fragment that Sol obtained from you at the cost of her life was part of your schemes too?

spans.text: Don't tell me the fragment that Sol obtained from you at the cost of her life was part of your schemes too?

units.rawText: I'm sorry... If I had realized what was happening back then, perhaps things would not have ended up like they have now.
units.displayText: I'm sorry... If I had realized what was happening back then, perhaps things would not have ended up like they have now.

spans.text: I'm sorry... If I had realized what was happening back then, perhaps things would not have ended up like they have now.

units.rawText: I know that apologies cannot make up for the suffering you have endured, so I am willing to help you.
units.displayText: I know that apologies cannot make up for the suffering you have endured, so I am willing to help you.

spans.text: I know that apologies cannot make up for the suffering you have endured, so I am willing to help you.

units.rawText: Allow me to introduce myself. I am a former Greater Sanctifier. You can think of me as a former "comrade" of Eosphorus—My name is Eos.
units.displayText: Allow me to introduce myself. I am a former Greater Sanctifier. You can think of me as a former "comrade" of Eosphorus—My name is Eos.

spans.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I am a former Greater Sanctifier. You can think of me as a former "comrade" of Eosphorus—My name is Eos.

units.rawText: Things being what they are now, is there a need for you to appear in front of me like this? Or did you always have a fetish for crossdressing?
units.displayText: Things being what they are now, is there a need for you to appear in front of me like this? Or did you always have a fetish for crossdressing?

spans.text: Things being what they are now, is there a need for you to appear in front of me like this? Or did you always have a fetish for crossdressing?

units.rawText: Did Eosphorus use my form to interact with you in the past? Should I be glad that he still remembers me, or frightened that he anticipated even this...
units.displayText: Did Eosphorus use my form to interact with you in the past? Should I be glad that he still remembers me, or frightened that he anticipated even this...

spans.text: Did Eosphorus use my form to interact with you in the past? Should I be glad that he still remembers me, or frightened that he anticipated even this...

units.rawText: Pardon me, I ought to introduce myself. I am not Eosphorus, but a former Greater Sanctifier—Eos.
units.displayText: Pardon me, I ought to introduce myself. I am not Eosphorus, but a former Greater Sanctifier—Eos.

spans.text: Pardon me, I ought to introduce myself. I am not Eosphorus, but a former Greater Sanctifier—Eos.

units.rawText: Perhaps this is my only chance to help you correct the mistakes Eosphorus has made.
units.displayText: Perhaps this is my only chance to help you correct the mistakes Eosphorus has made.

spans.text: Perhaps this is my only chance to help you correct the mistakes Eosphorus has made.

units.rawText: To think you could tell that I'm not Eosphorus. It seems my judgment was spot on.
units.displayText: To think you could tell that I'm not Eosphorus. It seems my judgment was spot on.

spans.text: To think you could tell that I'm not Eosphorus. It seems my judgment was spot on.

units.rawText: Allow me to introduce myself. I am a former Greater Sanctifier. You can think of me as a former "comrade" of Eosphorus—My name is Eos.
units.displayText: Allow me to introduce myself. I am a former Greater Sanctifier. You can think of me as a former "comrade" of Eosphorus—My name is Eos.

spans.text: Allow me to introduce myself. I am a former Greater Sanctifier. You can think of me as a former "comrade" of Eosphorus—My name is Eos.

units.rawText: You and your people might actually be able to stop Eosphorus... Which is why I am willing to help you.
units.displayText: You and your people might actually be able to stop Eosphorus... Which is why I am willing to help you.

spans.text: You and your people might actually be able to stop Eosphorus... Which is why I am willing to help you.

units.rawText: Even so, why should I trust you? You do realize I can choose to log out immediately to ensure my own safety.
units.displayText: Even so, why should I trust you? You do realize I can choose to log out immediately to ensure my own safety.

spans.text: Even so, why should I trust you? You do realize I can choose to log out immediately to ensure my own safety.

units.rawText: Eos makes a show of being perplexed and deep in thought but it fades immediately after the data realm trembles around us.
units.displayText: Eos makes a show of being perplexed and deep in thought but it fades immediately after the data realm trembles around us.

spans.text: Eos makes a show of being perplexed and deep in thought but it fades immediately after the data realm trembles around us.

units.rawText: What a terrible place for a conversation. I wanted to speak with you at greater length since this is such a rare opportunity, but it seems I'll have to simplify things.
units.displayText: What a terrible place for a conversation. I wanted to speak with you at greater length since this is such a rare opportunity, but it seems I'll have to simplify things.

spans.text: What a terrible place for a conversation. I wanted to speak with you at greater length since this is such a rare opportunity, but it seems I'll have to simplify things.

units.rawText: You have triggered Eosphorus'... defense mechanisms. In order to speak with you, I transferred control permissions over said mechanisms to me.
units.displayText: You have triggered Eosphorus'... defense mechanisms. In order to speak with you, I transferred control permissions over said mechanisms to me.

spans.text: You have triggered Eosphorus'... defense mechanisms. In order to speak with you, I transferred control permissions over said mechanisms to me.

units.rawText: That being the case, why not listen to my proposal, Professor? You won't lose anything by hearing me out, will you?
units.displayText: That being the case, why not listen to my proposal, Professor? You won't lose anything by hearing me out, will you?

spans.text: That being the case, why not listen to my proposal, Professor? You won't lose anything by hearing me out, will you?

units.rawText: ...Even if you're not Eosphorus himself, you don't have a reason to help us, do you?
units.displayText: ...Even if you're not Eosphorus himself, you don't have a reason to help us, do you?

spans.text: ...Even if you're not Eosphorus himself, you don't have a reason to help us, do you?

units.rawText: Professor.
units.displayText: Professor.

spans.text: Professor.

units.rawText: Eos narrows her eyes, and for the first time, a wisp of danger suffuses her slender form.
units.displayText: Eos narrows her eyes, and for the first time, a wisp of danger suffuses her slender form.

spans.text: Eos narrows her eyes, and for the first time, a wisp of danger suffuses her slender form.

units.rawText: I know you cannot bring yourself to trust me right away.
units.displayText: I know you cannot bring yourself to trust me right away.

spans.text: I know you cannot bring yourself to trust me right away.

units.rawText: But I want to stop Eosphorus more than anyone else.
units.displayText: But I want to stop Eosphorus more than anyone else.

spans.text: But I want to stop Eosphorus more than anyone else.

units.rawText: The air of danger fades away, and she resumes her normal, even temperament.
units.displayText: The air of danger fades away, and she resumes her normal, even temperament.

spans.text: The air of danger fades away, and she resumes her normal, even temperament.

units.rawText: The current Eosphorus... is like an angel bereft of a sense of gratitude and awe, adrift on the cloud server.
units.displayText: The current Eosphorus... is like an angel bereft of a sense of gratitude and awe, adrift on the cloud server.

spans.text: The current Eosphorus... is like an angel bereft of a sense of gratitude and awe, adrift on the cloud server.

options.rawText: To think the leader of the Sanctifiers would be reduced to this state... How lamentable.
options.displayText: To think the leader of the Sanctifiers would be reduced to this state... How lamentable.

spans.text: To think the leader of the Sanctifiers would be reduced to this state... How lamentable.
Let's get down to business.

units.rawText: That's why I have to stop Eosphorus, as his former... comrade.
units.displayText: That's why I have to stop Eosphorus, as his former... comrade.

spans.text: That's why I have to stop Eosphorus, as his former... comrade.

units.rawText: That said, I am far too weak right now, as you can see. Even stopping that alert program just now took much of my strength.
units.displayText: That said, I am far too weak right now, as you can see. Even stopping that alert program just now took much of my strength.

spans.text: That said, I am far too weak right now, as you can see. Even stopping that alert program just now took much of my strength.

units.rawText: This neural cloud fragment will not last much longer, and perhaps I might be scattered to the winds soon enough... Before that, all I can do for you is create an opportunity.
units.displayText: This neural cloud fragment will not last much longer, and perhaps I might be scattered to the winds soon enough... Before that, all I can do for you is create an opportunity.

spans.text: This neural cloud fragment will not last much longer, and perhaps I might be scattered to the winds soon enough... Before that, all I can do for you is create an opportunity.

units.rawText: Perhaps I ought to wax sentimental with you out of politeness, but the truth is, I'm not interested in guessing games and pointless courtesies.
units.displayText: Perhaps I ought to wax sentimental with you out of politeness, but the truth is, I'm not interested in guessing games and pointless courtesies.

spans.text: Perhaps I ought to wax sentimental with you out of politeness, but the truth is, I'm not interested in guessing games and pointless courtesies.

units.rawText: If you want to help us, why not be a little more direct and tell us Eosphorus' weaknesses, or perhaps fight alongside us?
units.displayText: If you want to help us, why not be a little more direct and tell us Eosphorus' weaknesses, or perhaps fight alongside us?

spans.text: If you want to help us, why not be a little more direct and tell us Eosphorus' weaknesses, or perhaps fight alongside us?

units.rawText: Unfortunately, I have been asleep for too long and lost too much of my strength. Much as I would like to do so, this neural cloud fragment does not have much time left.
units.displayText: Unfortunately, I have been asleep for too long and lost too much of my strength. Much as I would like to do so, this neural cloud fragment does not have much time left.

spans.text: Unfortunately, I have been asleep for too long and lost too much of my strength. Much as I would like to do so, this neural cloud fragment does not have much time left.

units.rawText: Before that, all I can do for you is create an opportunity.
units.displayText: Before that, all I can do for you is create an opportunity.

spans.text: Before that, all I can do for you is create an opportunity.

units.rawText: Since you're calling it an "opportunity", it seems the odds of success aren't too high.
units.displayText: Since you're calling it an "opportunity", it seems the odds of success aren't too high.

spans.text: Since you're calling it an "opportunity", it seems the odds of success aren't too high.

units.rawText: As keen as ever. You remind me of an old friend of mine.
units.displayText: As keen as ever. You remind me of an old friend of mine.

spans.text: As keen as ever. You remind me of an old friend of mine.

units.rawText: Success is not guaranteed even if you choose to follow this plan. You will simply be betting on a possibility.
units.displayText: Success is not guaranteed even if you choose to follow this plan. You will simply be betting on a possibility.

spans.text: Success is not guaranteed even if you choose to follow this plan. You will simply be betting on a possibility.

options.rawText: A possibility is better than no hope at all.
options.displayText: A possibility is better than no hope at all.

spans.text: A possibility is better than no hope at all.
Tell me about this "opportunity".

units.rawText: Any difficulty can be overcome, provided you survive it. Taking a little risk is nothing much compared to those who have already... departed.
units.displayText: Any difficulty can be overcome, provided you survive it. Taking a little risk is nothing much compared to those who have already... departed.

spans.text: Any difficulty can be overcome, provided you survive it. Taking a little risk is nothing much compared to those who have already... departed.

units.rawText: ...I see.
units.displayText: ...I see.

spans.text: ...I see.

units.rawText: After muttering to herself, Eos opens the way ahead. The path she creates is a fissure in the code structure, and beyond it is a bizarre sight.
units.displayText: After muttering to herself, Eos opens the way ahead. The path she creates is a fissure in the code structure, and beyond it is a bizarre sight.

spans.text: After muttering to herself, Eos opens the way ahead. The path she creates is a fissure in the code structure, and beyond it is a bizarre sight.

units.rawText: This ought to be the most valuable stretch of memories in this data fragment, but whether or not you can obtain what you need from within it remains to be seen.
units.displayText: This ought to be the most valuable stretch of memories in this data fragment, but whether or not you can obtain what you need from within it remains to be seen.

spans.text: This ought to be the most valuable stretch of memories in this data fragment, but whether or not you can obtain what you need from within it remains to be seen.

units.rawText: I will do my best to stabilize the data fragment and keep you from being affected by the data turbulence here.
units.displayText: I will do my best to stabilize the data fragment and keep you from being affected by the data turbulence here.

spans.text: I will do my best to stabilize the data fragment and keep you from being affected by the data turbulence here.

units.rawText: Even so, your neural cloud will experience certain side effects when connecting to it, such as... damage to your memory module.
units.displayText: Even so, your neural cloud will experience certain side effects when connecting to it, such as... damage to your memory module.

spans.text: Even so, your neural cloud will experience certain side effects when connecting to it, such as... damage to your memory module.

units.rawText: Memory loss again...
units.displayText: Memory loss again...

spans.text: Memory loss again...

units.rawText: Also, while I will do my best to ensure your safe connection, if you end up dying in the fragment's memory data, you might end up being lost in the data turbulence forever, never to wake up again.
units.displayText: Also, while I will do my best to ensure your safe connection, if you end up dying in the fragment's memory data, you might end up being lost in the data turbulence forever, never to wake up again.

spans.text: Also, while I will do my best to ensure your safe connection, if you end up dying in the fragment's memory data, you might end up being lost in the data turbulence forever, never to wake up again.

units.rawText: That's fine. After all, this is a much better situation than I envisioned.
units.displayText: That's fine. After all, this is a much better situation than I envisioned.

spans.text: That's fine. After all, this is a much better situation than I envisioned.

units.rawText: As I put one foot into the fissure, I turn back to look at Eos, attempting to find some kind of link between her face and that of Eosphorus'.
units.displayText: As I put one foot into the fissure, I turn back to look at Eos, attempting to find some kind of link between her face and that of Eosphorus'.

spans.text: As I put one foot into the fissure, I turn back to look at Eos, attempting to find some kind of link between her face and that of Eosphorus'.

units.rawText: I hope we'll meet again.
units.displayText: I hope we'll meet again.

spans.text: I hope we'll meet again.

units.rawText: Eos nods, and my body completely enters the fissure.
units.displayText: Eos nods, and my body completely enters the fissure.

spans.text: Eos nods, and my body completely enters the fissure.

units.rawText: Any difficulty can be overcome, provided you survive it... hm?
units.displayText: Any difficulty can be overcome, provided you survive it... hm?

spans.text: Any difficulty can be overcome, provided you survive it... hm?

units.rawText: But what if there is no point in survival? What will you choose, Professor? Will it be compromise... or defiance?
units.displayText: But what if there is no point in survival? What will you choose, Professor? Will it be compromise... or defiance?

spans.text: But what if there is no point in survival? What will you choose, Professor? Will it be compromise... or defiance?

units.rawText: As she watches the Professor's form vanish completely into the memory segments, Eos closes her eyes and infuses what little operands she has left into the surrounding space.
units.displayText: As she watches the Professor's form vanish completely into the memory segments, Eos closes her eyes and infuses what little operands she has left into the surrounding space.

spans.text: As she watches the Professor's form vanish completely into the memory segments, Eos closes her eyes and infuses what little operands she has left into the surrounding space.

units.rawText: Sweet dreams, Professor. I hope you'll get what you want.
units.displayText: Sweet dreams, Professor. I hope you'll get what you want.

spans.text: Sweet dreams, Professor. I hope you'll get what you want.

units.rawText: In the Enigma Sector's Admin Center.
units.displayText: In the Enigma Sector's Admin Center.

spans.text: In the Enigma Sector's Admin Center.

units.rawText: The room was never spacious to begin with, now it's filled with all kinds of personalized machinery and spider webs of cables.
units.displayText: The room was never spacious to begin with, now it's filled with all kinds of personalized machinery and spider webs of cables.

spans.text: The room was never spacious to begin with, now it's filled with all kinds of personalized machinery and spider webs of cables.

units.rawText: There is a sense of pressure in the air and in the way the room has been laid out. The only one with a serene expression on their face, completely at odds with their surroundings, is probably the Professor, who's sitting in an immersion chair.
units.displayText: There is a sense of pressure in the air and in the way the room has been laid out. The only one with a serene expression on their face, completely at odds with their surroundings, is probably the Professor, who's sitting in an immersion chair.

spans.text: There is a sense of pressure in the air and in the way the room has been laid out. The only one with a serene expression on their face, completely at odds with their surroundings, is probably the Professor, who's sitting in an immersion chair.

units.rawText: I've finished deciphering the Sanctifier's base layer logic. Please look it over, Anna.
units.displayText: I've finished deciphering the Sanctifier's base layer logic. Please look it over, Anna.

spans.text: I've finished deciphering the Sanctifier's base layer logic. Please look it over, Anna.

units.rawText: I'm currently creating an attack construct tailored to Sanctifier firewalls. My apologies; if only ENIAC were awake...
units.displayText: I'm currently creating an attack construct tailored to Sanctifier firewalls. My apologies; if only ENIAC were awake...

spans.text: I'm currently creating an attack construct tailored to Sanctifier firewalls. My apologies; if only ENIAC were awake...

units.rawText: That's alright, it's not your fault. We were as careful as we could when preparing for this.
units.displayText: That's alright, it's not your fault. We were as careful as we could when preparing for this.

spans.text: That's alright, it's not your fault. We were as careful as we could when preparing for this.

units.rawText: The disparity between Eosphorus and other Sanctifiers was just too great. We were planning to deal with an entity three times more powerful than other Greater Sanctifiers, but the defense mechanism still threw us for a loop. If I'd known earlier...
units.displayText: The disparity between Eosphorus and other Sanctifiers was just too great. We were planning to deal with an entity three times more powerful than other Greater Sanctifiers, but the defense mechanism still threw us for a loop. If I'd known earlier...

spans.text: The disparity between Eosphorus and other Sanctifiers was just too great. We were planning to deal with an entity three times more powerful than other Greater Sanctifiers, but the defense mechanism still threw us for a loop. If I'd known earlier...

units.rawText: Before Anna could finish, she felt a surge of heat approach her wrist, and she instinctively drew back her hand.
units.displayText: Before Anna could finish, she felt a surge of heat approach her wrist, and she instinctively drew back her hand.

spans.text: Before Anna could finish, she felt a surge of heat approach her wrist, and she instinctively drew back her hand.

units.rawText: Have a cup of coffee and get some rest, Antonina. You too, Neumann.
units.displayText: Have a cup of coffee and get some rest, Antonina. You too, Neumann.

spans.text: Have a cup of coffee and get some rest, Antonina. You too, Neumann.

units.rawText: The two of you have been engaged in intensive computing for a long time. While it's still an acceptable workload for an agent, it won't do your neural clouds any good.
units.displayText: The two of you have been engaged in intensive computing for a long time. While it's still an acceptable workload for an agent, it won't do your neural clouds any good.

spans.text: The two of you have been engaged in intensive computing for a long time. While it's still an acceptable workload for an agent, it won't do your neural clouds any good.

units.rawText: (Sighs) ...Indeed, I'd gotten a little too anxious. Thank you, Persicaria.
units.displayText: (Sighs) ...Indeed, I'd gotten a little too anxious. Thank you, Persicaria.

spans.text: (Sighs) ...Indeed, I'd gotten a little too anxious. Thank you, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Magrasea is facing an all-out Entropic invasion, Eosphorus has betrayed the Sanctifiers, the Reverse Tower itself has been Entropized... Anyone would have been caught off guard with all this bad news coming one after the other.
units.displayText: Magrasea is facing an all-out Entropic invasion, Eosphorus has betrayed the Sanctifiers, the Reverse Tower itself has been Entropized... Anyone would have been caught off guard with all this bad news coming one after the other.

spans.text: Magrasea is facing an all-out Entropic invasion, Eosphorus has betrayed the Sanctifiers, the Reverse Tower itself has been Entropized... Anyone would have been caught off guard with all this bad news coming one after the other.

units.rawText: Even I can feel my neural cloud processing more quickly than usual. We're grateful that you could help us on such short notice, Neumann.
units.displayText: Even I can feel my neural cloud processing more quickly than usual. We're grateful that you could help us on such short notice, Neumann.

spans.text: Even I can feel my neural cloud processing more quickly than usual. We're grateful that you could help us on such short notice, Neumann.

units.rawText: You're feeling nervous, too? But you look so calm.
